856-5776-6798-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

501-586-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

225-2557-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-2557-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1669-3756-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

301-713-2813.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-713-2813.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1172-3245.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Exsanguinate by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
1172-3245.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Exsanguinate.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

4019-4221-7677--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Cast Shimmerwilds Growth by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to that land and choosing "blue".
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Shimmerwilds Growth triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
4019-4221-7677--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-1879-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-1879-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5400-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5400-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5400-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-5477-6321-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

64-372-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3693-4613-6843-7267.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Michelangelo.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-1603--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Evil Twin that has haste. Choose to have Evil Twin enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Evil Twin token instead.
618-1603--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Evil Twin's toughness.

997-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

147-997-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

1456-1987-3139-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2783-2972-3470-6455.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Nesting Dragon trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve a Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3480-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

575-5971-6297.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5971-6297.description:
Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
When King Darien XLVIII dies, Yedora triggers, returning King Darien XLVIII from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When King Darien XLVIII enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate King Darien XLVIII by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning King Darien XLVIII face-up.
Resolve the King Darien XLVIII ability from step 1.
Repeat.

478-804-1358-2821-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-1358-2821-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using Sydri
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

2713-2816-4315.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
2713-2816-4315.description:
Activate the creature with Careful Cultivation and Umbral Mantle attached by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and untapping it, causing it to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

533-776-1306-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
533-776-1306-1329.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing Mana Crypt, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mana Crypt from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing creatures you control to get +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the second trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat.

237-1812-2034-4893-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orzhov Enforcer, adding {C}{C}.
When Orzhov Enforcer dies, its afterlife ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning Orzhov Enforcer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Kenrith's other abilities.

2661-3327-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2661-3327-5256.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Repeat.

719-969-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Xenograft.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
719-969-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1242-2228-2850.notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
It is your turn.
1242-2228-2850.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, causing target player to discard a card.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cinderhaze Wretch.
Repeat.

uses.n: Dennick, Pious Apprentice // Dennick, Pious Apparition

1872-2882-4472.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
1872-2882-4472.description:
Cast Dennick, Pious Apparition from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {2}{W}{U}.
Dennick, Pious Apparition enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Dennick, Pious Apparition by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

3859-4191.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

262-728.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
262-728.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a number of Elemental tokens with haste equal to Grimgrin's power.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Elemental token to untap Grimgrin and to put a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin.
Repeat.

1231-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
1231-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.
